summary: Tested the CloudIVR Live calls features end to end in preview dry-run, against the backend API and the UI. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass. Covered GET /campaigns/live (shape, pipeline counts, upcoming sort order, newest-first feed with in-flight calls first, daily-limit flags, 401 when signed out, isolation from Bob/Carol), GET /campaigns/:id live/feed/areas/nextRun (another account gets 404), repeat and dailyLimit checks (invalid_repeat, invalid_daily_limit for 0/10001/2.5, scheduling refused with dry_run), weekly repeat create (seriesId==id, runNumber 1, doNotCall=1 for a Bulk IVR campaign), stop-repeat (ok, a second call gives 400, a non-repeating campaign gives 400), multi-number /ai-dnc (added 2 / invalid 1, legacy {number}, 400, list, delete) and dashboard liveCampaigns. Frontend: everything requested works: Live nav item with green dot (gone for an account with nothing running), Live page tiles, cards, pipeline, stats and daily-limit note, pause, resume preview toast, Stop confirm dialog, name link, feed results, Coming up list, empty state; campaign detail run plan, next-run link, stop-repeat confirm then toast then pill hidden then next run cancelled, pipeline, run stats, Do-not-call stat, live feed, top areas; new campaign form (repeat select + hint, daily limit) creating a campaign with 'Repeats every week' and '0 / 50 calls today'; campaign list repeat pills and Watch live button; Do-not-call page multi-add toast, rows, remove with undo, and the same list under the AI agents tab; FR/ES translations; 390px phone: no horizontal overflow, feed shown as a stacked list, More menu Live item and dot. Found 3 minor issues and no blockers.

minor.issue: Upcoming runs are cancelled BEFORE updateMany({status in created/scheduled/running/paused}) sets repeat:null, so the cancelled next run keeps repeat:'daily'. Verified: after stop-repeat, seed-live-next = {status:'cancelled', cancelledReason:'Repeat stopped', repeat:'daily'}. Opening that cancelled run shows the 'Repeats every day' pill and the 'Stop repeating' button (DetailLive renders on c.repeat only), and the campaign list still shows a repeat pill for it. Fix: clear repeat on the whole series (include 'cancelled'), or run the updateMany before cancelling.

issues: The upcoming item subtitle stays in English: 'Repeats every day' (e.g. '27 oct, 21:31 · 15 números · Repeats every day'). The same label in the campaign card pill is translated ('Se repite cada día' / 'Se répète chaque jour').

design_issues.screen: Campaign detail stats vs pipeline (data consistency)
issues: The stat cards and the 'x of y called' line use stats.completed/answered (8 called, 4 answered), while the pipeline shows Done 7 and the Live summary counts answered only for finished calls (3 for that campaign). With the seed this is because seed stats() counts the in-flight 'answered' lead. Please confirm the real engine never increments stats.completed while a call is still talking; if it does, the numbers on the same card disagree.

action_items: stopRepeat: also set repeat:null on the runs it cancels (or run the updateMany first) so cancelled runs don't show the 'Repeats every day' pill or the 'Stop repeating' button
Translate the 'Repeats every day/week' subtitle in the Live page 'Coming up' items (fr/es)
critical_code_review_comments: campaign-live.js GET /campaigns/live loads at most 60 docs sorted by createdAt desc (running/paused/scheduled + finished today). An account with many scheduled or old campaigns could miss an older running campaign in the summary. Consider separate queries for active and today's campaigns.
The Live endpoint sends the full leads array of up to 60 campaigns through Mongo on every 5s poll. Consider a projection or limiting leads for big campaigns (MAX_BULK_LEADS) to save load.
areasOf counts keyPressed for in-flight calls but answered only for finished ones. Small mismatch; the '1 pressed a key' label can be higher than answered for a moment.
Spanish 'Llamando' is used for the Ringing phase ('Sonando' would be clearer).

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all requested flows pass; 1 minor i18n gap)
